explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.
Each sweep's hypothesis was written before the runs, and is quoted beside that sweep's measured result below.

hero.html: 52 configurations over 7 sweeps (pipeline-topology, batch-caps, kv-capacity, moe-collective, prefix-cache, prefill-chunking, cudagraph), each at 5 load levels, every run on exactly 8 GPUs.

1x TP4xPP2 + EP (gpu mem util 0.95 · KV dtype fp8), from the kv-capacity sweep, reached 13.07 tok/s/accelerator (104.5 tok/s across the fleet) at concurrency 4 while holding the scenario's SLOs. 25 runs were refused and are not counted as misses: 2 configurations (10 runs): scenario: engine vllm 0.32.0: vllm: kv: To serve at least one request with the model's max seq len (262144), (3.55 GiB KV cache is needed, which is larger than the available KV cache memory (0.37 GiB). recommendation_prose: The table below lists the measured operating points. Headline ranking: max output tok/s per accelerator subject to the scenario's SLOs. The Pareto front of every sweep is in pareto.json.

prose: TP8 should peak highest, since each pipeline stage adds a boundary hop to every decode step.
Measured: best was 1x TP4xPP2 + EP at 12.3 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 4).
sections.title: Sweep: pipeline-topology

prose: A seq cap of 8 should bind on TP8 at 16+ lanes, while a small token budget trades throughput for tail ITL on both shapes.

Measured: no configuration that ran in this sweep held the SLOs at any tested load. Refused: 2 configurations (10 runs): scenario: engine vllm 0.32.0: vllm: kv: To serve at least one request with the model's max seq len (262144), (3.55 GiB KV cache is needed, which is larger than the available KV cache memory (0.37 GiB). Based on the available memory, the estimated maximum model length is 12144. Try increasing `gpu_memory_utilization` or decreasing `max_model_len` when initializing the engine (vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_utils.py:2636-2646@5df63a72).
sections.title: Sweep: batch-caps

prose: fp8 KV should matter most on TP8, where 0.95 leaves almost no KV room, and substitute for memory on the pp shapes.
Measured: best was 1x TP4xPP2 + EP (gpu mem util 0.95 · KV dtype fp8) at 13.07 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 4).
sections.title: Sweep: kv-capacity

prose: DeepEP low-latency should win at small decode batches on both shapes, and matter more at EP width 8 than 4.
Measured: best was 1x TP4xPP2 + EP at 12.3 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 4).
sections.title: Sweep: moe-collective

prose: Turning the prefix cache off should collapse throughput on every shape, since AgentX re-sends a growing shared context.
Measured: no configuration in this sweep held the SLOs at any tested load.
sections.title: Sweep: prefix-cache

prose: Capping long prefills should trade a little peak throughput for a much lower ITL p99 at saturation.
Measured: best was 1x TP4xPP2 + EP (prefill chunk 8,192) at 12.3 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 4).
sections.title: Sweep: prefill-chunking

prose: FULL-family capture should beat the PIECEWISE default by a few percent, and NONE should collapse.
Measured: no configuration in this sweep held the SLOs at any tested load.
sections.title: Sweep: cudagraph
